CONSTITUTION OF CAMPUS CRUSADE FOR CHRIST
BOISE STATE UNIVERSITY CHAPTER
Article I: Name
The name of this organization shall be Campus Crusade for Christ.
Article II: Object
Campus Crusade for Christ is an interdenominational, student, Christian seeking to
provide a spiritual environment for students.
Article III: Membership
Membership is open to anyone who has an active interest in its activities, and who are in
agreement with the policies of Campus Crusade for Christ.
Article IV: Officers
The officers of BSU Campus Crusade for Christ shall be president, vice president,
treasurer and secretary
Article V: Meetings
Regular meetings will be held weekly for all who are interested. Special meetings may be
called whenever necessary.
Article VI: Advisor
The advisor to Campus Crusade for Christ will be chosen by the officers and full-time
staff members of Campus Crusade for Christ. The advisor will be a member of the BSU
faculty

SOUTHEASTERN COMMUNITY COLLEGE STUDENT ORGANIZATION:
CAMPUS CRUSADE FOR CHRIST
Name of Organization
Campus Crusade for Christ
Purpose of Organization
Campus Crusade for Christ exists to provide regular opportunities to study and discuss the Bible, worship, and
pray, all in a group setting, which also provides opportunities for fellowship, encouragement and spiritual among
members. We seek to be a resource to the student body by offering opportunities to discuss spiritual matters and
provide materials in the form of speakers, video’s, books and articles, all for their benefit and consideration.
Membership
Campus Crusade for Christ has an open-door policy. All members of the Southeastern Community College,
as well as any interested persons outside Southeastern College, are welcome to attend the Bible studies and
meetings. There are no “members” in the sense of meeting requirements or being accepted into membership.
Campus Crusade for Christ was formed by Christians who agree in their belief that man’s only access to God is
through Jesus Christ and faith in His deity, His death as full payment for man’s sins, and His resurrection. While
this is the foundation for the Bible study, those holding other beliefs are welcome to attend.
Officers
Campus Crusade for Christ does not have officers. However, a small group of participants with a strong
commitment to the maintenance of the organization agree to be named as a steering committee for the purpose
of financial responsibility communication with Southeastern Community College administration. These persons
are named in a separate document. At the end of the 2011-2012 academic year, those steering committee
members who will graduate from Southeastern Community College will, in group conference, select successors
to be named to the committee. Selection will be based upon an appointment by the steering committee at the last
Bible study in the 1996 spring semester, and agreement by those selected.
Meetings
Campus Crusade for Christ will meet each week on campus at a time and place yet to be determined. Additional
prayer meetings and committee meetings will also meet on campus. Additional special meetings or activities will
be arranged informally through personal communication through posting flyers on the School campus.

Finance
To date, the organization has not requested Southeastern Community College Student Activity funds. The weekly
meetings involve no expenses. Extra activities, such as concert attendance, parties, dinners, and such, have
been individually paid for by each participant or by the Campus Crusade for Christ International headquarters.
In the future, if the majority of participants believe it is an appropriate request, Student Activity funds may be
requested through procedures established by the Office of Student Life.
By-Laws
Due to the unstructured nature of Campus Crusade for Christ and its purpose, is unlike most other student
organizations, by-laws are not seen as or necessary. Because it exists as a study and discussion group with
the students of Southeastern Community College, the organization does not operate on the basis of rules or
prescribed format which would be subject to change and, thus, require by-laws.
Steering Committee Practices
Campus Crusade for Christ International headquarters reserves the right to review and revise the SECC chapters
constitution, steering committee practices, meetings and other related leadership positions from time to time
as deemed just and necessary. SECC Campus Crusade for Christ chapter adopt and adhere to the practices and
beliefs of the Campus Crusade for Christ’s stated purposes and objectives and statement of faith.
